subject.title: fix: stop blocked tool loops stalling until timeout

question: After refreshing the branch, should this availability fix and the validation-routing repairs land together once the exact merged head passes the remaining QA and compact checks?
rationale: The runtime repair intentionally changes when an agent turn terminates, while the same branch includes test-routing changes that were added to repair validation regressions exposed during exact-head CI; maintainer intent is needed to accept that combined landing scope.

options.title: Refresh, verify, and land together
options.body: Rebase onto current `main` and merge the complete branch if the exact merged head passes the remaining compact and QA checks, preserving the runtime proof path.

options.title: Split validation hardening
options.body: Land the loop-breaker repair separately only if the test-router and isolated-UI changes can be independently validated without reopening the current-main CI regressions.

recommendation.title: Refresh, verify, and land together
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main` and merge the complete branch if the exact merged head passes the remaining compact and QA checks, preserving the runtime proof path.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor assembled the runtime repair and its validation path; a repository owner should make the final merge decision after exact-head checks complete.
